description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing employee claim requests within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving (single and multiple), and action handling related to employee claim requests. The class leverages various traits for authentication, ORM helpers, date/time, normalization, and user role management. It also incorporates detailed validation rules, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and handles filtering, pagination, and access control logic.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing employee claim requests, allowing creation, retrieval, and processing of claim-related actions within the HRM system.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new claim request for a specified employee, validating inputs and associating claim event and currency details.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim requests, supporting filtering, sorting, pagination, and different response models (detailed or summary).

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific claim request by ID, including allowed actions and owner information, with access control.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: setClaimRequest
methods.description: Internal method to populate a ClaimRequest object with data from the request, validate claim event and currency, and save it within a transaction.

methods.name: getClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Creates a new filter parameters object for searching claim requests.

methods.name: getEndPointCollectionResult
methods.description: Produces the appropriate collection result object based on the requested model (detailed or summary).

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets employee number filters based on request parameters, ensuring access rights.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets whether to include employee details in the response based on query parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns default behavior for including employee details.

methods.name: getCommonFilterParams
methods.description: Populates common filter parameters such as reference ID, event ID, status, from and to dates.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number from route parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Determines permissible workflow actions for a given claim request based on user roles and status.
